svg.text: Combinational forward transforms and byte organization implemented by the RTL
ROM image: mem/sbox.mem; no registered S-box output.
Fixed byte permutation; row r rotates left by r bytes.
Two RTL instances: Initial AddRoundKey at the top level, and AddRoundKey inside AES Round.
Source: rtl/core/{sub_bytes, sbox_byte, shift_rows, mix_columns, add_round_key, key_expansion}.v
